prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool (edit mode on Image 1) to make exactly 2 separate images from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
Repaint the attached exact top-down city plan of Gharn (first image) as a beautiful illustrated fantasy game map, keeping the layout EXACTLY: every road, plaza, building footprint, yurt circle, tree dot, wall line, field and the round central arena must stay at the same position, size and shape - do not move, add or remove anything, do not change the outline of the city. North is up. Style: the dark crimson and gold UI kit of the attached inventory screen - a map painted on dark aged lacquered paper in deep black-red tones, buildings drawn as small hand-painted top-down roofs (red-lacquered tiled roofs for houses and the palace, ivory felt for yurts, blue-slate roof for the guild hall), paved roads as worn grey stone with subtle cobble texture, trails as packed earth, wooden palisade with small towers in the corners, sakura trees as tiny pink blossom crowns, the central arena as a circular stone amphitheatre with tiers and a sand floor, outer steppe with dry grass and nomad yurts, crop fields south of the gate, subtle ink wash shading, soft crimson glow on lanterns, thin gold border around the whole sheet, faint seigaiha pattern in the margins. NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO icons, NO compass, NO legend - the game will add them. Crisp, high detail, readable at small size, top-down orthographic view.
Input images: Image 1: edit target — change only what is asked, keep everything else identical; Image 2: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: square 1:1.
